== Composed 2017 primary source ==
[[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|Official PC Decipher Errata sheet]], official text as of 1 June 2017, page 21. Original rectangle <code>[216.95399475097656, 546.9840087890625, 395.82598876953125, 630.8160400390625]</code>, background xref 384, occurrence 8. Actual composed vector text/icons are retained.

The sheet edition and repository imports identify preserved source occurrences; they do not establish unknown first-publication days. In particular, the full face in the initial 2018 import may predate that import, so its original first-publication order relative to the 2017 partial is not independently established. The dated occurrences therefore do not independently settle their original publication sequence.

Printed fields: game text, Effect/Interrupt type bar, unnumbered E. Verified uncovered fields: printed host title, uniqueness, destiny, lore. No new playable ID is assigned. Existing historical ID fields are inherited without a loader-support claim. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 14 November 2026 (UTC).
